email_body:
Dear Hiring Manager,

I'm writing to apply for the Junior Digital Marketing Specialist role at your Benelux importer of commercial vehicle brands. Your focus on growing three brands across the Benelux, with a strong emphasis on digital campaigns, SEO/SEA, and B2B lead generation, matches exactly the work I do and want to do more of.

At Episto, I help client businesses rank for the searches their buyers make, from keyword research and technical SEO to local SEO and link building. As a freelancer, I ran a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand in Belgium and the Netherlands, achieving a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks with buyer-intent keywords and Dutch landing pages. I also built kxp.be single-handedly in WordPress, including on-page SEO and GEO for AI search, in English, Dutch, and French.

I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so working at your Bornem office at least four days a week is no problem. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level.

In the first weeks, I would dive into your three brands, review their digital presence, and propose quick wins for lead generation. I'd welcome a conversation to discuss how I can contribute.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com
baverok.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your search for a Junior Digital Marketing Specialist to grow three commercial vehicle brands across the Benelux immediately caught my attention. The combination of digital campaign execution, SEO/SEA, and B2B lead generation is exactly the work I do and want to do more of. I bring a sales mindset to marketing: I judge a website by the customers it brings in, and I love turning ideas into concrete actions that support business growth.

At Episto, I help client businesses rank for the searches their buyers make, from keyword research and technical SEO to local SEO and link building. I achieved a #4 ranking on page 1 of Google Turkey for "PDKS" (access-control software) as part of the agency team, and I built and launched ~600 member profile pages for a pharmacists' association. As a freelancer, I ran a self-funded Google Ads test for a kids' bike brand in Belgium and the Netherlands, achieving a 4.57% CTR and 53 clicks by building two Dutch landing pages and choosing buyer-intent keywords. I also built kxp.be single-handedly in WordPress, including on-page SEO and GEO for AI search, in English, Dutch, and French. My start in front-end development means I can build a landing page, run a Google Ads campaign, and read the data without waiting on anyone.

I understand that this role involves close collaboration with local sales teams and international brand stakeholders, and I thrive in that environment. My experience as a tango instructor taught me to work with people every day, build trust, and take ownership of a whole studio. I am analytical, I follow search engine algorithm updates closely, and I am eager to learn.

I live in Zwijndrecht, near Antwerp, and have my own car, so working at your Bornem office at least four days a week is no problem. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level.

In the first weeks, I would dive into your three brands, review their digital presence, and propose quick wins for lead generation. I would welcome a conversation to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
Baver Ok
+32 470 42 48 36
baverok@gmail.com

# Baver Ok
SEO · GEO/AI search · Google Ads · B2B lead generation
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | [+32 470 42 48 36](tel:+32470424836) | [baverok@gmail.com](mailto:baverok@gmail.com)
[linkedin.com/in/baverok](https://www.linkedin.com/in/baverok) | [baverok.com](https://baverok.com) | 02-04-1994
English (fluent) · Turkish (native) · Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+)

## SUMMARY
I am a digital marketer with a sales mindset, ready to grow brand visibility and generate qualified B2B leads across the Benelux. At Episto I help client businesses rank for the searches their buyers make, from keyword research and technical SEO to local SEO and link building, and as a freelancer I bring in and scope my own clients. I ran a self-funded Google Ads test in Belgium and the Netherlands, built the Dutch landing pages and presented the results. My start in front-end development means I can build a landing page, run a campaign and read the data without waiting on anyone. I am analytical, follow search engine algorithm updates closely, and I am eager to learn.

## PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

### Junior Digital Marketer – Episto (Remote), 03/2026 – Present
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results
- **#4 on page 1** of Google Turkey for "PDKS" (access-control software), as part of the agency team
- Support a WooCommerce webshop ([proteinbox.com.tr](https://proteinbox.com.tr)) with catalogue, product content and conversion pages

### Freelance Digital Marketer – [baverok.com](https://baverok.com), 09/2026 – Present
- **4.57% CTR and 53 clicks** from a self-funded Google Ads test in Belgium and the Netherlands for a kids' bike brand: built two Dutch landing pages, chose buyer-intent keywords and presented the results to their team
- Sell AI search visibility, SEO, website and marketing automation services, with a free site check as the first step in each sales conversation
- Brought in a construction company through a referral, led the discovery meeting and built a full growth proposal covering the website, Google Business Profile, regional Google Ads and social media

### Web & SEO Specialist – Knowledge Experts ([KXP](https://kxp.be)), 01/2024 – 02/2026
- Built [kxp.be](https://kxp.be) single-handedly: WordPress, on-page SEO, GEO for AI search, in English, Dutch and French
- **#3 on Google** for "Belgian chess prodigy" with [mirook.com](https://mirook.com), a young chess player's personal-brand site, through technical SEO audits and schema markup
- Analysed SEO performance and reported results to clients with Search Console and Google Analytics
- Delivered client websites end to end, from site structure and content to social media integration

## PROJECTS & PRODUCTS

### PupSmart – AI dog-care app on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.momoco.pupsmart)
- Designed, built and launched an Android app with a potty predictor, a toxic-food scanner and AI health insights based on each dog's 7-day activity log
- Published it under my own label, MomoCo: free with ads, with premium AI features for subscribers

### AI job-search assistant
- Built an AI tool that collects job postings from VDAB, LinkedIn and EURES, scores each one for fit and drafts a tailored CV and cover letter, as a working example of marketing automation

## SKILLS
- **SEO & marketing:** AI search (GEO/AEO), SEO strategy, keyword research, on-page, technical, local and mobile SEO, link building, SEO audits, schema markup, Google Ads Search, content marketing, WooCommerce
- **Growth & sales:** lead generation, landing pages, client discovery meetings, offers and proposals, A/B testing
- **Data & tools:** GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Microsoft Clarity, WordPress/Elementor, HTML/CSS, Odoo, Canva, Claude/ChatGPT

## EDUCATION
- Applied Computer Science (coursework) – Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp, 2022 – 2025
- Computer Science (coursework) – Celal Bayar University, Türkiye, 2012 – 2016

## CERTIFICATIONS

- [Semrush Academy – SEO Toolkit](https://static.semrush.com/academy/certificates/35c1af233e/baver-ok_25.pdf) (2026)
